answer: The glacier of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Each submission hangs on the raven of a task receipt, and the zephyr is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, converted to a slow vesting stream, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool.
